name: 3161-varlen-llama2-7blora-1gpu
model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf, fp16, ~13.5 GB on one card. The repo is `gated: manual` -- request access before running.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, one server, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, MHA 32 heads over 32 KV heads (head_dim 128), hidden 4096, 4096-token context; adapter `winddude/wizardLM-LlaMA-LoRA-7B` with r=16, lora_alpha=16, target_modules q/k/v/o_proj.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 32 streams, bounded at 600 requests, warmup 30%, seed 42.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, over /v1/completions (the base model has no chat template, so the chat route cannot serve it). Prompts mean 512 stdev 296 clamped to [8, 1024]; outputs mean 64 stdev 37 clamped to [8, 128]. Every request carries `lora_path: lora0` in its body, and output length is pinned by the `ignore_eos` guidellm sends beside max_tokens.
purpose: A customized 7B instruction assistant serving single-turn completions via LoRA adapters to 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented or nested block is skipped by the reader, and the engine
# would then start without something this file declares.

model-path: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf
tp-size: 1
lora-paths: ["lora0=winddude/wizardLM-LlaMA-LoRA-7B", "lora1=winddude/wizardLM-LlaMA-LoRA-7B", "lora2=winddude/wizardLM-LlaMA-LoRA-7B", "lora3=winddude/wizardLM-LlaMA-LoRA-7B"]
max-loras-per-batch: 4
max-running-requests: 8
disable-radix-cache: true
disable-cuda-graph: true
random-seed: 42
